note: IMD Kolkata issues a thunderstorm warning with squall for Paschim Bardhaman district, gusts of 70 to 90 km/h expected from 16:00.
Storm control room activated at the Asansol divisional office. Twelve line gangs placed on standby across the Hirapur, Kulti and Raniganj sections.
Squall line reaches Asansol. Gusts of 96 km/h recorded at the Burnpur monitoring mast, with heavy rain and hail reported at Jamuria.
First outages recorded on the 11 kV Burnpur feeder BNP-04 after a tree fell across the conductor near Burnpur bazaar.
Line gangs 1 to 6 dispatched to the Hirapur and Burnpur sections.
Cascading outages across the Kulti and Barakar sections after multiple poles tilted on the KLT-02 feeder.
First consumer notification issued by SMS and IVR to affected service connections.
Peak consumers without supply recorded at 74,600 across 41 feeders.
Snapped 11 kV conductor reported at Neamatpur More. Area cordoned and the section isolated.
Mutual aid requested from the Durgapur and Purulia distribution circles.
Damage assessment reports 34 poles snapped or tilted, 52 spans of conductor down and 9 distribution transformers damaged.
Restoration underway. The 33 kV sub-transmission faults were cleared first.
Outage management system link to the Asansol data centre lost. Consumer counts are not recorded from this point.
Mutual-aid gangs from the Durgapur circle arrive on site.
Outage management system link restored after 3 hours 30 minutes. Counts resume.
First consumer count after the outage management system link was restored.
Estimated restoration times published on the consumer portal and issued by WhatsApp broadcast.
Restoration continues across the Kulti and Barakar sections.
Lineman injured at Raniganj: minor laceration while clearing a fallen span, treated on site, no lost time.
Hirapur and Burnpur sections substantially restored.
Second bulk notification issued with revised estimated restoration times.
Restoration continues on the Jamuria and Salanpur laterals.
Tree-cutting gangs reassigned to the Barakar corridor to clear gang access along the feeder route.
Barakar corridor access cleared and conductor stringing begins.
Remaining outages are individual service connections requiring separate gang visits.
Gang visits proceeding on the remaining individual service connections.
Notification issued to the remaining consumers with a same-day restoration commitment.
Remaining outages reduced to under four thousand consumers.
All snapped-conductor sites cleared and released for normal operation.
Final consumer restored. Event closed.
Post-event review scheduled. 34 poles, 52 spans and 9 distribution transformers replaced.
All-clear message issued to all affected service connections.
